objective: Provide a reusable explicit-config CLI to score saved one-session forecast bundles and generate private hash-bound JSON and Markdown reports; correct the PRSG-183 archived replay evidence where the reusable implementation identified a return-unit mismatch.

checks.description: Run the CLI over the private PRSG-183 source bundles and compare eligible counts, source hashes and model-separated results with its established private archive score.
evidence: Private replay using PRSG-183 benchmark-config.json produced 33 eligible and 99 excluded forecasts across the same three model hashes. Matched corrected PRSG-183 results exactly for eligible counts, direction hits and median absolute log-return errors. Outputs: ~/.codex/lead-state/PRSG-183/reusable-run-final/benchmark.json SHA-256 2fdfea64b0651ca030b750adeed76116d4db7891713f8b0606ed883197309b0e; benchmark.md SHA-256 025510af94ce15031c81870d270ff7ca570bcbc0cf22e1b647afa96c1891711f. No private inputs/results added to Git.
Ticket manifest and every changed path validated with scripts/planning/validate_ticket.py; git diff --check passed.

acceptance.description: Versioned explicit config produces a JSON and Markdown report in a new private output directory and never overwrites existing output.
evidence: Focused tests confirmed explicit versioned config output, private path enforcement and no-overwrite behavior.

acceptance.description: Scoring checks source availability and target compatibility, uses existing metric definitions, and keeps each model SHA separate.
evidence: Private archive replay produced 33 eligible rows in three separate model hashes and exactly matched corrected direction and median absolute log-return error metrics.

acceptance.description: Focused regressions and README instructions cover the reusable command/config and private-path constraints.
evidence: README includes the reusable command and documents private outputs/limitations; focused tests passed 3/3; ticket scope validation passed.

acceptance.description: Real private archive replay reproduces the PRSG-183 eligible count and model-separated scores without including private output in Git.
evidence: The reusable CLI replayed the private archive: 33 eligible, 99 excluded, with three model hashes separate. Direction hits and median absolute log-return errors match the corrected PRSG-183 score. Private report hashes are recorded in real-archive-replay evidence.

Lead reviewed scope, input/output privacy boundaries, log-return metric units, focused regressions, exact real archive replay and documentation. PRSG-183 historical score receipt was corrected and regenerated after the replay exposed its simple-return/log-return mismatch.
